YAML validated with in-repo means, no new dependency: parsed with the workspace's own `yaml` package, dumping the trigger block and all four job guards (parse exit 0), reading both key spellings ('on' / YAML-1.1 true) as check-required-contexts does; the four job guards read back exactly as designed. Toolchain note: check:doc-formula-expressions first failed ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on @objectstack/formula/dist — dependency closure not built; fixed by `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build` (flag BEFORE the filter — placing --concurrency after it forwarded the flag to tsup and broke sdui-parser), then green. All heavy commands ran through scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh. DECLARED NARROWING: repo-wide `pnpm lint` was not run; narrowing measured rather than assumed — `npx eslint --format json` over both changed paths reports 2 files / 0 errors, each 'File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied', so the population comes from eslint's own config resolution and both changed files fall outside it entirely; config invariance holds because this diff changes no eslint config and no TypeScript. dispatch-gates residue examined rather than treated as clearance: the 2 silent families whose roster sits under .github/workflows are both check:single-claim-paths, whose SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS declares exactly one entry (.objectui-sha), so that silence is correct. Card-named scripts checked for trigger-shape assertions: scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs and scripts/pm/check-release-page-status.mjs assert nothing on release.yml's triggers (grep for version-pr/event_name returns empty; half-states' only release.yml reference is a card-body string). Landing class on the FINAL file list: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test .github/workflows/release.yml docs/releases-maintenance.md` → 'governed-surface predicate: 0 of 2 path(s) hit the register (5 surfaces, repo-agnostic). NOT governed — ordinary queue landing applies to a PR with exactly this file list.' Opened as DRAFT regardless, per dispatch. skip-changeset applied as a union with the bot labels then READ BACK: labels are now [documentation, ci/cd, size/m, skip-changeset]. CI convergence not awaited — reporting at draft-PR time per the 2026-08-10 ruling; gate status on the PR is in_progress.",

    "filed as #11239: docs/releases-maintenance.md still describes the pre-ADR-0125 publish lane in three sentences — 'Both lanes are workflow_dispatch ... neither can be started by a push', the GA table's 'then dispatch' Trigger cell, and the GA step telling a releaser to Run workflow 'with the version main now carries' (the typed version ADR-0125 D2 removed). Pre-existing, not caused by this card; left untouched because one sits inside the 2026-08-07 ruling narrative and correcting them is a separate reading of ADR-0125.",
    "NOT filed, needs PM triage: #10850 is OPEN and pm:queue for substantially this same goal ('switch the changesets version workflow from every-merge-to-main to manual dispatch before a release'). It is not assigned or dispatched, so there was no in-flight race, but #11238 implements it. No closing keyword was written for it anywhere in the PR body or commit message; #10850 remains open for the PM to decide."
  ]
